name: rotate_in_place
purpose: Turn an object by dyaw_deg degrees where it lies (it ends within 2 cm of where it was).
evidence: the goal needs the teal box cutter turned 90 degrees in place; pick/place_at keep the orientation unless yaw is given, and no primitive turns an object without moving it.
explanation: rotate_in_place captures the object's fresh pose, picks it, and places it back at the identical centre with yaw = original yaw + dyaw (normalized). It verifies the result and, if off by >1cm or >5°, performs one corrective pick/place with a compensated yaw. Passed 10/10 randomised layouts across +90, -90, +45 and 180 degree tests, staying within 2cm and 10° and not displacing other objects.
